CustomField.description: Flow-managed. Number of non-Final exit Document_Checklist__c rows (Case_Creation_Rule__c is null) on this Case. Maintained by Doc_Checklist_Completion_Sync_Flow. Exists so Case_Completion_Update_Flow re-runs when an open exit doc is added to a Case whose All_Exit_Docs_Final__c is already false.
CustomField.label: Exit Docs Open Count
